name: Sefirotic Bus

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Ein Sof which encompasses the entire emanative structure

VINIT.justification: The absolute nothingness preceding the first point of light

TANCH.justification: The final vessel that contains and grounds the entire flow of light

AFWD.justification: The directed ray of light descending from the source into the void

AREV.justification: The returning light that reflects from the lower vessels back to the source

CLINK.justification: The sequential contraction and linking of divine attributes to form a path

IMSCRIB.justification: The crown which is the self-identical point of origin and will

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the initial flash into wisdom and understanding

FFUSE.justification: The non-sefirah that unifies wisdom and understanding into knowledge

EVALT.justification: The expansive force of loving-kindness and affirmation

EVALF.justification: The restrictive force of judgment and negation

ENGAGR.justification: The beauty that balances and holds mercy and severity in tension

IFIX.justification: The permanent impression or trace left in the void after the light withdraws

phase_3.void_description: The state of Ayin before the first contraction occurs
phase_3.true_description: The state of Chesed where divine light flows without restriction
phase_3.false_description: The state of Gevurah where divine light is withheld or limited
phase_3.both_description: The state of Tiferet where expansion and restriction coexist as harmony

steps.domain_action: The emergence of the void through the initial Tzimtzum
The manifestation of Keter as the primary point of divine will
The descent of the Kav into the vacuum to begin the bus cycle
The bifurcation of the light into the pillars of Mercy and Severity
The activation of the right pillar through Chesed
The activation of the left pillar through Gevurah
The synthesis of the pillars within the central column at Tiferet
The unification of the intellectual attributes into the state of Daat
The sequential transmission of the unified signal through Netzach and Hod
The recording of the transmission state within the foundation of Yesod
The grounding of the signal in the physical terminal of Malkuth
The reflection of the signal as returning light to verify the cycle

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Kav which translates divine intent into structured emanations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The 22 paths of the Hebrew alphabet connecting the sefirot
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Reshimu which stores the impressions of previous light states
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The rhythmic pulse of Ratzo V'Shov or running and returning
phase_5.alfs_store: The Sefer Yetzirah which provides the structural logic for the bus

phase_6.cycle_cost: The concealment of the infinite light required to manifest finite vessels
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The undifferentiated light of the Ein Sof
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The structured light within the vessels of the world of Atzilut
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system operates as a closed loop where returning light restores the initial state
